role_applied_for.title: SEO / AEO Lead
role_applied_for.source: Ashby public job-board API (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/helpscout), fetched 2026-11-25: 'with the help of your manager, the Director of Demand Generation'

reporting_chain.evidence: Director of Demand Generation posting live on LinkedIn Jobs, Remotivated, RemoteBoard and others, all dated about 6 days before 2026-11-25 (Google results via Bright Data); the posting says it reports to the VP of Marketing
VP of Marketing postings from August 2026 (Techstars, Built In) say it reports to 'Andrea, our CRO'; no public announcement or LinkedIn snippet names a current holder

Google LinkedIn snippet 'Andrea Kayal - Chief Revenue Officer ... Experience: Help Scout'; RocketReach 'Chief Revenue Officer at Help Scout'; podcast 'Now at Help Scout, she runs the entire commercial organization'; the VP of Marketing posting names 'Andrea, our CRO'

recipient.name: Andrea Kayal
recipient.title: Chief Revenue Officer, Help Scout
recipient.why: The role's manager (Director of Demand Generation) is itself an open hire and no VP of Marketing is publicly in post, so the most senior person the role rolls up to who is verifiably in place is the CRO, who runs the commercial organization including marketing.
recipient.email_note: No personal helpscout.com address was found in any public source read (only role addresses: help@, research@, editorial@, partnerships@). Verify with Hunter before sending.
recipient.linkedin_company_check: Help Scout's CRO per Google LinkedIn snippet; the profile itself was not opened

alternates.title: VP of Marketing
alternates.note: If the sponsor finds a current VP of Marketing (the role's skip-level manager), that person is the better recipient.
